fields.label: Department
fields.note: No filter control in the page shell; values come from the company's collected records. The live /api/careers payload groups India roles by Client_Name (Engineering) and publishes no department on US Greenhouse rows.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: USA/India are separate tabs in the UI, not query parameters; values are the live listing's location labels.

notes: Next.js careers page calls GET https://cyware.com/api/careers (no query string) and renders usJobs (Greenhouse board 'cyware') plus indiaJobs (Zoho Recruit). The USA/India tabs and the India Client_Name grouping are client-side; no keyword or facet parameter is sent, so all filtering must be local.
